target.title: fix: complete pinned repair validation
target.body:
## Summary

- complete the remaining acceptance criteria from https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/492 after https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/494 landed
- prove four moving-main review attempts keep one captured base and final synchronization receives one exact validation/review
- classify a validation failure as external only after the same command reproduces the same normalized diagnostic on an isolated pinned-base checkout
- prepare dependencies independently inside the pinned checkout; fail closed when safe setup is disabled/fails, dependency inputs changed, or the pinned ref is unavailable
- preserve repair scope for changed or ambiguous diagnostics, document the final-sync contract, and retain reporter credit here while leaving release-owned changelog files untouched

## Root cause

The first landed repair pinned the main execution paths and renewed publication credentials, but its moving-base coverage was source-level and its validation path did not deterministically distinguish a genuine pinned-base failure from a repair-induced failure reported in an unchanged file.

## Validation

- `pnpm run lint:repair`
- `pnpm run test:repair` — 714 passed
- `pnpm run test:coverage:changed` — 100% lines/functions, 88.61% branches
- `pnpm run format:check`
- focused built repair/CLI suite — 59 passed
- source-blind behavior contract — all 6 clauses passed, including invalid-base rejection
- autoreview — clean; no accepted/actionable findings

Hosted proof on the first exact head:

- Linux/Windows CI: https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29146638078
- CodeQL: https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29146638063
- ClawSweeper review: https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/actions/runs/29146639484

That live review caught dependency contamination in the first pinned-base checkout implementation. The first follow-up rejected tracked dependency-input changes; exact-head re-review then proved that ignored/generated mutations could still contaminate a shared runtime, and that rejecting all prepared runtimes made the classifier unreachable in the normal path. The final implementation never shares `node_modules`: it installs from pinned inputs inside the detached checkout when setup is enabled, and preserves repair scope when independent setup is unavailable. Integration coverage exercises normal setup followed by a base-identical failure, the requested untracked runtime mutation, unstaged/staged/committed dependency changes, and an unavailable pinned ref.

## Final-head live proof

Built `dist/repair`, then exercised its exported setup, validation, pinned reproduction, and classifier against a real temporary Git repository while advancing main and rebasing the repair. Both checkouts performed an actual npm install of a committed local dependency; no command or package-manager mocks were used. Redacted output from exact head `4aec301eb83626021dc0f91fde5892bfa06b22f4`:

```text
repaired_runtime_ready=true
repair_validation_failed=true
isolated_pinned_validation_failed=true
external_blocker=true
blocker_paths=check.mjs,src/base.ts
advanced_main_delta=src/base.ts
repair_delta=src/repair.ts
```

The advanced-main path remained base-identical in the synchronized tree while the preserved repair delta contained only `src/repair.ts`, proving the terminal external-blocker boundary after independent pinned-checkout setup and final reconciliation.

`pnpm run check` reaches the existing macOS harness failures unchanged from `origin/main`: two Bash 3.2 lowercase-expansion tests and one missing-Corepack fixture. The repair suite and changed-surface gates are green; hosted Linux CI remains the full-suite authority.

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/492

commands.review_summary:
The PR adds isolated pinned-base validation reproduction, conservative external-blocker classification, one bounded final synchronized validation/review, documentation, and focused repair-lane regression coverage.

Reproducibility: yes. https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/issues/492 documents two concrete moving-main failures, and this branch adds deterministic Git integration coverage plus final-head live output for the same boundary.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] No separate repair job or human product decision is needed; this opted-in PR should remain on its guarded exact-head automerge path while pending checks finish.
